description: Light Polish/English stemmer and diacritic folding for keyword matching. The tables are the kernel's (loom/data/lexicons/stemming.json, kb::Normalizer) — reused, not copied; this file only adds entries. Forms are shown in 'why it matched'.

short_terms.note: terms shorter than the stemmer's min_token (baza, Anna) also match as a prefix with a short ending (bazy, bazie, Annę), except in text recognised as English
